## Checklist

- [ ] No private or identifiable personal information is included.
- [ ] Mental health boundaries remain clear.
- [ ] Version differences and highlights are explained.
- [ ] README translations are updated if needed.
- [ ] Links work with relative paths.
- [ ] The change is reusable by people other than the author.
